items.text: The full engine has no automatic Windows build or run; only the Win32 platform harness is cross-built and run under Wine, and all MSVC lanes are manual.
GDI's cross-built examples are not registered with CTest in a cross tree; GDI's only automatic CTest route is the manual native workflow.
The MinGW runtime-copy helpers only warn when a runtime DLL cannot be located, so a built tree can fail to start in a clean prefix; a documented design choice, not a defect.

items.section: Windows II: Wine and Engagement Gates
items.text: The Direct2D Wine lane has no d2d1 engagement marker and every Direct2D registration bypasses the DXVK gate, so which Direct2D implementation ran is shown only by environment controls.

CnaTests links -sJSPI=1 while, as a CNA-owned executable without CNA_EMSCRIPTEN_ASYNCIFY=OFF, it also receives -sASYNCIFY=1; its comment still describes a -fwasm-exceptions root ABI. Whether the two suspension settings conflict was not established.

items.section: Web III: Five Renderers, Four Kinds of Evidence
items.text: Only HTML_DOM has an automatic browser run; SVG_DOM's browser runner has no workflow or CTest caller, CANVAS/WEBGL1/WEBGL2 have no browser harness, and WEBGL1 is built by no workflow.

items.section: Web III: Five Renderers, Four Kinds of Evidence
items.text: htmldom-ci.yml's header comment says the suite drives four pages; run-htmldom-test-suite.sh runs six (stale comment).

Android has no workflow or preset; the only execution records are emulator runs of an earlier revision with no retained artifacts, and content loading through ContentManager inside an APK is untested.
Mobile lifecycle handling is covered only by a portable test; no device or emulator test drives background, foreground, low memory or process recreation.
iOS evidence is a device final-link and one simulator frame; no physical device run exists, and tvOS/watchOS/visionOS are refused at configure time.
ctest -R '^Metal' matches host-portable Metal_PortableHelpers on any host, so a Metal pass without the renderer identity is ambiguous evidence (a design choice).
No CNA code resolves an Apple application bundle's Resources directory for content; a relative content root depends on the working directory and SDL's file-open rules, untested for a launched bundle.
